resources.string: Tenshu Control is installed but isn't set up on this device yet. Photos keeps your library in Control — open it to start fresh or join your other devices, then come back.
Tenshu Control isn't installed on this device. Photos keeps your library through Control, so there's nothing to show until it's installed.
Tenshu Control isn't installed on this device, and it isn't in the store yet — your library stays empty until it is.
Tenshu Control isn't installed on this device. Install it the same way you installed Photos.
Can't reach Tenshu Control — your photos can't load. Make sure Control is installed and running.
Photos is newer than Tenshu Control on this device. Update Control to keep your photos syncing.
Tenshu Control is newer than Photos on this device. Update Photos to keep your photos syncing.
Photos and Tenshu Control disagree on a data version. Update both to keep your photos syncing.
This device is behind the rest of your realm and has stopped receiving photos. Update Tenshu Control to catch up.
This device is behind the rest of your realm and has stopped receiving photos. Update Photos to catch up.
This device is behind the rest of your realm and has stopped receiving photos. Update Photos and Tenshu Control to catch up.
This device is behind the rest of your realm and has stopped receiving photos. Update Tenshu on this device to catch up.
